entities.name: Jack G. Hills
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Jack Gilbert Hills is a theorist of stellar dynamics. He worked on the Oort cloud; the inner part of it, the Hills cloud, was named after him. The Hills mechanism is also named after him.
